visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair and black glasses, wearing a dark brown sleeveless top, sits in an indoor office setting. She holds a small black microphone to her mouth and speaks directly to the camera. The background features white slatted walls and a black lamp. (2) A man in red shorts is shown jumping into a bright blue swimming pool, surrounded by green trees and foliage in daylight. (3) The woman returns to the screen, gesturing with her hands and pointing her finger to emphasize her points. Yellow and white text captions appear at the bottom of the frame. She wears a gold watch, a bracelet, and a necklace. (4) A close-up static image displays the sole of a human foot with two prominent, hardened circular skin lesions. (5) The woman is shown again, continuing her explanation with varied hand movements and facial expressions. The lighting is bright and even. (6) While the woman speaks, stylized red and orange flame animations and text overlays related to temperature appear near her hands, indicating a point of emphasis. (7) The final shot is a white graphic end screen featuring the clinic's logo, LINE ID, phone number, and two physical addresses in black and grey text.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: DR 美上美皮膚科診所. [Subtitle]: 夏天到了最容易發生的兩個皮膚疾病. (2) [Subtitle]: 要超級小心喔!! (3) [Subtitle]: 大家會去游泳池. 記得你去游泳池之後呢. 一定要穿自己的拖鞋. 千萬不要光著腳丫踩在那個地板上. 你很容易得到兩個疾病. (4) [Slogan]: 第一個叫香港腳. [Subtitle]: 第一個叫香港腳. 香港腳就是發生在很濕的環境裡面. 腳裡面長了霉菌. 你的腳就會無比的癢. 那另外一個呢叫做. (5) [Slogan]: 病毒疣. [Subtitle]: 病毒疣. 腳上會長那個一顆一顆很硬的. 有時候看起來像雞眼的一個小東西. 那這個東西呢它是會傳染的. 得到病毒疣我覺得比得到香港腳來得痛苦很多. 因為香港腳你擦擦藥它就會好. 如果得到病毒疣還沒有藥好擦. 你就是一定要去做這個冷凍治療. (6) [Subtitle]: -179.5度去凍你的腳. 這其實就拿火去燒的意思是一樣. 其實很痛的. (7) [Logo]: DR 美上美皮膚科診所. DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC. [Slogan]: LINE @drx.derm. 02-8985-9060. 新北市三重區正義北路104號2F. 台北市中山區南京東路一段96號. 歡迎聯繫我們 contact us.
